rationale: Retain a surface busway option for scenario analysis, conditional on full scope, route fit and garage/access delivery. Newmarket is a local construction-to-opening reference, not a complete target programme.

Retain surface LRT under an explicitly tight delivery envelope. Finch West early utilities to opening is about nine years; that observation does not include all preceding development or guarantee Finch East delivery.

User adopts a conservative base-case policy against an unvalidated underground delivery programme and unallocated depot/access within nine years. Existing LRT duration and Line 1 depot needs motivate caution; neither proves a subway lower-bound duration or zero Wilson capacity.
